chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to me from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb, from Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan, from ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah, from his father, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
The sun was eclipsed while I was in the bathhouse, and I came to know only after I had come out, so I did not make it up.

key_terms.أَقْضِ: I make up the missed prayer

ai.seo_question: Is the eclipse prayer made up if someone only learns about the eclipse after it has ended?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a case concerning salat al-kusuf during a solar eclipse. It indicates a ruling-related precedent about one who only learns of the eclipse after the time has passed and does not perform a make-up prayer.
